* Policy work. Imitation learning (ACT, diffusion policies), visual servoing, observation\-space design. Our experience matches the published literature here: what you condition the policy on matters more than which backbone you pick.
* Perception glue. Segmentation and tracking models feeding structured observations to controllers. Lots of SAM2, DINOv2, and small task\-specific networks.
* Deployment. Getting the above onto real hardware, at real control frequencies, without it falling over on hour four.


 You will also do unglamorous things: fix the data loader, chase a 20 Hz timing mismatch, re\-cut a fixture, sit next to the cell and watch it fail 40 times. This is the job.
   

  

 What we're looking for
   

  

**Required**
* Strong Python. You've written code other people had to maintain.
* Comfort with PyTorch — you can read a training loop and know where to put a breakpoint.
* Enough Linux and git to be self\-sufficient.
* Empirical instincts. When something doesn't work, your first move is to isolate a variable, not to change three things and re\-run.
* Currently enrolled in CS, EE, ME, robotics, or equivalent — or you can demonstrate the skills some other way. We care about the second clause.


**Nice to have** 
 (genuinely optional — we don't expect all of these)
   

  

* Hands on real robots: ROS/ROS2, arm kinematics, cameras, calibration.
* Familiarity with modern manipulation policies — ACT, Diffusion Policy, VLAs (π0, RDT, OpenVLA, GR00T).
* CAD, fixturing, or any ability to make a physical thing exist.
* You've run an experiment that failed and can explain precisely why.


**What We Don't Require**
* Publications.
* Prior internships.
* Knowing the specific model families above. If you can learn fast and debug carefully, the domain is learnable in weeks.


 How we work
   

  

* Small scope, real ownership. You'll own something that ships, not a side quest that gets archived in September.
* Evidence over vibes. We read papers, and we assume their numbers are optimistic until we reproduce them. Independent verification is a first\-class activity here.
* Honest failure reporting. Telling us early that an approach isn't working is more valuable than making it look like it is.
* Physical reality wins. A load cell and an if\-statement beat an elegant policy that can't sense the thing it needs to sense.

**Why AssemblyAI**
 AssemblyAI builds the best\-in\-class Voice AI models powering the next generation of voice applications. The Voice AI space is at an inflection point; we’re looking for folks truly excited to join a small team and help define the future of the industry.
   

  

 We are one of the most capital\-efficient AI companies on the planet \- with under 100 people generating roughly $500K ARR per employee, we sit among the top 5 most revenue\-dense teams within the fastest\-growing AI companies today. With thousands of customers including Granola, Fireflies, Figure AI, and CallRail, the company has real scale \- processing over 2 million hours of audio daily and handling more than 1 million API calls every day. **About The Role**
 We're looking for an Applied AI Engineer to join our team at the intersection of cutting\-edge AI research and real\-world customer applications. This is a highly dynamic, customer\-facing technical role where you'll build demos, troubleshoot production issues, and help customers implement our Speech AI models in creative and impactful ways.
   

  

 You'll be working directly with developers and technical teams at companies ranging from early\-stage startups to enterprise organizations. Your days will involve rapid context\-switching between building prototypes for new use cases, debugging urgent customer issues, and collaborating with our Sales, Success, Engineering, Product, and Research teams to ensure customers succeed with our platform.
   

  

 This role requires strong technical skills, excellent communication abilities, and the creativity to solve novel problems under time pressure. You'll be empowered to use AI tools and modern development practices to deliver solutions quickly and effectively.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
**Customer\-Facing Technical Work (60%)**
* Guide customers through their entire product journey—from initial implementation and technical onboarding, through development and testing, all the way to production deployment. Continue to provide support post\-launch to ensure their implementation is performing optimally and meeting their business objectives
* Build custom demos and prototypes that showcase how AssemblyAI's models can solve specific customer use cases
* Lead technical discovery sessions with prospects and customers to understand their requirements and design optimal implementations
* Assist with competitive evaluations by providing benchmarks, designing fair comparison tests, and helping customers evaluate our models against alternatives. Work closely with customers to ensure they have the data and support needed to make informed decisions
* Troubleshoot production issues for customers using our streaming and async APIs, sometimes requiring you to debug code in languages you may not use daily (Java, Go, Ruby, etc.)
* Provide technical guidance on architecture, scaling, data privacy, and best practices for integrating our APIs
* Create proofs\-of\-concept that demonstrate the "art of the possible" with Speech AI
* Travel to customer sites for technical workshops, implementation support, and relationship building with key accounts


**Internal Collaboration \& Product Influence (30%)**
* Serve as the voice of the customer to our Product and Research teams—test and dogfood new products and features before they reach customers, providing feedback from a practitioner's perspective. Advocate for improvements and new capabilities based on real\-world use cases you encounter, ensuring our roadmap aligns with customer needs
* Contribute to documentation, guides, and example code that help developers integrate our APIs more effectively
* Identify patterns in customer issues and work with Engineering to address root causes (SDK improvements, better error messages, new features)
* Collaborate with Sales and Success teams to ensure smooth handoffs and consistent customer experience
* Participate in team off\-sites to align on strategy, share learnings, and build team cohesion

**About The Company**
 Verisk is a leading data analytics and risk assessment company dedicated to providing innovative solutions across various industries, including insurance, reinsurance, financial services, and energy. With a global presence and a commitment to leveraging cutting\-edge technology, Verisk helps organizations make informed decisions by transforming complex data into actionable insights. **About The Role**
 We are seeking a highly skilled Senior Software Engineer with deep expertise in AI/ML engineering and data\-intensive systems to join our Catastrophic and Risk Solutions team at Verisk. This role involves being a pivotal technical contributor in a dynamic, agile environment, developing cloud\-native SaaS platforms that sit at the intersection of advanced scientific research and production software. The successful candidate will have a unique opportunity to design and ship AI\-powered features, build scalable data pipelines, and architect robust ML\-serving infrastructure on AWS. This position is based in our Boston office, offering a flexible hybrid work model that balances collaboration and remote work. As a senior member of the team, you will influence technical strategy, mentor junior engineers, and contribute to innovative solutions that address real\-world risk management challenges.
   

  

**Qualifications**
 The ideal candidate will possess a strong educational background in computer science, mathematics, statistics, or a related quantitative field, with a master's or doctoral degree preferred. You should have at least five years of software engineering experience, including two or more years in a senior or lead role focused on cloud\-native AWS products. Proficiency in Python is essential, especially for data engineering, ML pipelines, and API development. Hands\-on experience with machine learning frameworks such as scikit\-learn, PyTorch, TensorFlow, or XGBoost is required, along with practical knowledge of deploying machine learning models into production environments. Familiarity with AWS services like SageMaker, S3, Glue, Athena, Lambda, EC2, and CloudWatch is crucial. Additionally, experience with data pipeline tools such as Apache Spark, Airflow, or dbt, and a solid understanding of data modeling and working with large\-scale databases are necessary. Strong grasp of software engineering fundamentals, including CI/CD, DevOps practices, testing, and system design, is expected. Knowledge of REST API design, microservices architecture, containerization with Docker and Kubernetes, and Agile methodologies will be advantageous.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**AI \& Data Engineering**
* Design, build, and deploy machine learning models and AI\-powered features into production SaaS products, ensuring scalability and robustness.
* Maintain and optimize scalable data pipelines for ingestion, transformation, and enrichment of large, complex datasets to support analytics and modeling efforts.
* Develop and implement model\-serving infrastructure utilizing AWS SageMaker, Lambda, and container\-based deployment patterns to facilitate real\-time and batch inference.
* Integrate large language models (LLMs), Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG) architectures, and generative AI capabilities to enhance product functionalities and user experiences.
* Ensure data quality, observability, and monitoring for all AI/ML workloads in production environments, implementing best practices for operational excellence.


**Software Engineering \& Architecture**
* Lead the design and development of cloud\-native microservices and RESTful APIs using Python, C\#/.NET, and other relevant technologies on AWS.
* Drive best practices in software design, code quality, and system architecture, fostering a culture of continuous improvement within the team.
* Participate in all phases of the software development lifecycle, including requirements analysis, system design, implementation, testing, and deployment.
* Conduct thorough code reviews to ensure adherence to engineering standards and mentor team members to elevate overall technical proficiency.
* Identify technical risks proactively, communicate challenges effectively, and implement solutions to mitigate issues early in the development process.
* Contribute to strategic planning, roadmap development, and feasibility assessments for new features and platform enhancements.
* Champion a customer\-centric approach by ensuring solutions effectively address client needs and deliver value through innovative technology.

 We are looking for an experienced software engineer with machine learning expertise to join us in expanding Moveworks NLU (natural language understanding) and agentic AI capabilities, enabling increasingly magical user experiences and improving Moveworks generative and conversational AI capabilities platform\-wide.
   

  

 As a member of the NLU team, you will have all the tools of modern NLP and NLG at your disposal, from best\-in\-class LLMs, multimodal foundation models, and hybrid vector databases to all the infrastructure needed to fine\-tune, evaluate, and serve your own models in production. * Use your knowledge of machine learning fundamentals and LLMs to design new algorithms and architectures, evaluate them with small scale experiments and productionize your solutions at scale
* Research and develop innovative, scalable and dynamic solutions to hard problems
* Use the latest advances in machine learning and LLMs to enhance our products and create delightful user experiences
* Spend time weekly reading, discussing, and potentially building models out of the latest ML research and open\-source code

**About The Role**
 Sales software was built for humans. But we believe most sales work will be done by agents within the next two years. We're building out multiple vertical products (AI Dialer, AI Prospecting, AI Sequencing, Agent Studio) to get there. Reps use Nooks as a "copilot" and spend 4\+ hours a day across these different product lines. If you want to build a category\-defining sales product, we'd love to hear from you.
   

  

 What you'll do
   

  

* Build AI features that drive revenue, end to end. Define the success metric, ship across React/TypeScript and Node.js/Python, and iterate until it moves. 1,100\+ customers depend on this product daily.
* Work directly with customers. Our biggest accounts have shared Slack channels with our engineers; you'll be on calls with users one day and shipping fixes back to them the next.
* Make foundational technical decisions. How should agent memory work per rep? What's the right primitive for a long\-running outbound strategy?
* Mentor others on the team. Run code and design reviews, and pair on the hardest problems.


**You Might Be a Strong Fit If**
* 3\+ years of engineering experience, with depth in something close to our stack (React, TypeScript, Node.js, Python).
* Production experience with AI features. For example, you've debugged misbehaving agents and built the evals to keep issues from recurring.
* Strong opinions, held loosely, about what the product surface of human\-agent collaboration should look like.
* Not afraid to hop on a call with a customer to validate a feature you just built.
* You learn fast and ask good questions.
* Based in San Francisco, excited to be in\-office 3\+ days per week.


 At Nooks You'll Enjoy
   

  

* A world\-class team. Around 40 engineers, mostly former founders or founding engineers and veteran builders from places like Applied Intuition, Scale, Airtable, Citadel, and Jane Street. Thirteen Olympiad medals across the team.
* Compounding learning. Sitting next to former founders and founding engineers is the fastest way to skip a few years of mistakes.
* Top\-of\-market compensation.
